items.title: Crypto PAC notches primary wins, but loses $2M Florida race
items.summary: A Fairshake spokesperson said that the PAC was “just getting started“ on its expenditures as part of efforts to fill US Congress with lawmakers friendly to the crypto industry.

items.title: Six-Bug Exploit Halts Maya Protocol After $1.4 Million in Bitcoin Stolen
items.summary: The cross-chain protocol said an attacker exploited six software flaws to drain Bitcoin and other assets, sending its CACAO token plunging.

items.title: Crypto campaign fund Fairshake faces $2 million setback in Florida primaries
items.summary: In a race that drew criticism to crypto's leading political action committee for featuring fake headlines in ads, Fairshake's expensive effort fell short.

items.title: FalconX, Ethena bring USDe backing assets into $1B institutional credit facility
items.summary: The $1 billion facility will deploy assets backing USDe into overcollateralized institutional loans, expanding Ethena’s sources of returns beyond crypto basis strategies.
